 name: Release
 
 on:

+      - name: Download release artifacts

+          name: release-artifacts
+          path: release-artifacts
+
+      - name: Render GitHub release body
+        env:
+          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.release_tag }}
+          RELEASE_VERSION: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.release_version }}
+          ALREADY_PUBLISHED: ${{ needs.npm.outputs.already_published }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          cat > release-artifacts/release-body.md <<EOF
+          Release \`${RELEASE_TAG}\` publishes \`@wsmy/antora-markdown-exporter@${RELEASE_VERSION}\`.
+
+          - Source commit: \`${{ needs.gate.outputs.release_sha }}\`
+          - npm publish: $( [ "${ALREADY_PUBLISHED}" = "true" ] && printf 'already present on npm, publish step skipped' || printf 'published from the certified tarball artifact' )
+          - Inspection report: attached as a release asset
+          EOF
+
+      - name: Publish GitHub release assets
+        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
+        with:
+          tag_name: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.release_tag }}
+          body_path: release-artifacts/release-body.md
+          files: |
+            release-artifacts/*.tgz
+            release-artifacts/inspection-report.json
+
+  promote-main:
+    needs:
+      - gate
+      - release-assets
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      contents: write
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout current repo
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 0
+          ref: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.release_sha }}
+
+      - name: Fast-forward main to released commit
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          git fetch origin main
+          git checkout -B main origin/main
+          git merge --ff-only "${{ needs.gate.outputs.release_sha }}"
+          git push origin main

-`make release` delegates to `npm publish`, so it should only be run when the package is ready to publish.
+The repository now uses a `develop` / `main` / semver-tag release model:
+
+- `develop` is the integration branch for normal change flow
+- `main` tracks published history
+- semver tags such as `v0.1.0` are the publish trigger
+
+From a clean `develop` worktree, `make release VERSION=v0.1.0` starts the release candidate by updating version files, committing `chore(release): start v0.1.0`, and pushing `develop`.
+
+After the candidate commit has passed CI on `develop`, rerun:
+
+```bash
+make release VERSION=v0.1.0 YES=1
+```
+
+With the same version, the release wizard switches to finalize mode, creates the tag, and pushes only the tag. The tag-triggered GitHub Actions workflow validates the tagged commit, publishes `@wsmy/antora-markdown-exporter`, attaches release assets, and fast-forwards `main` to the released commit.

+=== Release Flow Uses `develop`, `main`, And Semver Tags
+
+Three notes define the release operating model:
+
+* `Develop should be the integration branch while main tracks published history`
+* `Tag pushes should publish only certified develop commits`
+* `Develop-main-tag release migration must be coordinated across code docs and automation`
+
+In practical terms:
+
+* normal change flow targets `develop`
+* release candidates are prepared on `develop`
+* finalization is done by pushing a semver tag from a certified `develop` commit
+* `main` is advanced only after the tagged release workflow succeeds
+
+For local operators and maintainers, `make release VERSION=vX.Y.Z` starts or finalizes the release depending on whether the requested version matches the current package version.
+
+Why this matters for contributors:
+
+* it separates “integrated” from “published”
+* it keeps release publication tied to one immutable tag input
+* it means `main` is not the branch for normal feature integration anymore
+
+Provenance:
+
